Class ColumnType<TValue>

Namespace
ParquetNeo.ColumnTypes
Assembly
ParquetNeo.dll

Everything about storing one .NET type in a Parquet column: the column it gets by default, which columns of a file it can be read from or written to, and how a batch of values is converted to and from the physical type and passed to the column reader or writer. The built-in types are found with ColumnTypeRegistry; an own type derives from this class.

public abstract class ColumnType<TValue> : ColumnType

Remarks

A type works on batches: the cost of reaching it (a virtual call) is paid once per batch, and the per-value work is generic code that the JIT specializes. The type adapts to the column it is used with, so one instance serves any number of columns; the settings (Configure(ColumnSettings)) only decide the column it creates.
